in_marathi.name: Eashan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Eashan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ईश (Isha), meaning 'God', 'Lord'. Eashan is a revered name in Hindu mythology, associated with powerful deities and spiritual enlightenment.
